description: Eight buttons in 4HP, each firing a 1ms pulse at its own jack, with an All button and a polyphonic jack carrying all eight

params.text: Fires all eight triggers at once
Fires a 1ms pulse at the jack beside it

outputs.text: Carries one channel per section, each with that section's 1ms pulse
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time the button beside it, or the All button, is pressed

notes: the pulse is 1ms however long you hold the button, and is followed by a forced 1ms low, so no more than 500 can be fired per second
menu: Poly output channels: 1 (monophonic) up to 8 channels — sets how many of the eight sections the POLY jack carries, 8 unless you reduce it
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Trigger-high output-level — sets the voltage a trigger pulse carries during its 1ms high phase, 10V unless you change it
Trigger-low output-level — sets the voltage a trigger output carries between pulses, 0V unless you change it
